messages:
Marta: Quick idea 10m7: Build a small productized "safeguard pin" pilot for customers who need predictable behavior when we rotate models. It would be time-limited pins + migration playbook. Low overhead, clear SLAs.
Diego: Can you sketch the risk surface? biggest technical concerns I see: tokenization drift, embedding vector drift, and capacity fragmentation if many tenants request pins.
Marta: Yep. Risk list: tokenization/embedding drift, metric regressions, storage of older model artifacts for rollback, and billing disputes. We should aim for 2-week pilot with 2 customers.
June: For benchmarks, propose dual-run: offline eval on canonical eval set + live shadow sampling for 72h with A/B sampling. Key metrics: top1 F1 delta <= 0.4%, embedding-cosine drift <= 0.03 mean, hallucination alerts sampled <0.5%.
Ravi: Pricing note: charge a flat "pin reserve" fee for the duration if they expect >50 sustained qps so we don't starve shared pools. For <50 qps, let it be complimentary as part of onboarding. Also require a signed SOW for enterprise pins.
Marta: Operational constraints: pins auto-expire at TTL (default 14 days); ops can extend once via explicit approval. Also pinned tenants get a labeled reservation to avoid silent eviction.
ops-bot: Draft policy snippet for canary + rollback: 
```
pin_policy: {
  ttl_days: 14,
  max_extensions: 1,
  extension_approval: ["solutions","sales"],
  reserved_pool: true
}
canary_check: {
  shadow_window: "72h",
  min_live_samples: 2000,
  metrics: ["top1_f1_delta","embed_cosine_drift","hallucination_rate","p99_latency"],
  thresholds: {"top1_f1_delta":0.4,"embed_cosine_drift":0.03,"hallucination_rate":0.5,"p99_latency_ms":250}
}
rollback: {auto_trigger: true, notify: ["ops","product","customer-success"], manual_override: true}
```
June: Important: add a compatibility shim flag in the SDK for tokenization/embedding mismatch. SDK should surface a warning and optional adapter mode. This prevents silent vector drift for downstream retrievers.
Diego: From infra: we need a small artifact retention policy for old model binaries (14d+extension window) and a compact descriptor so we can quickly remap tenant routing. Storage cost small but needs bookkeeping.
Ravi: Customer comms draft: "We offer a temporary pin to keep your workloads stable during catalog changes. Pins are time-limited and are reviewed with Solutions/Sales. If there's a performance regression during the migration canary, we'll execute rollback and work with you on migration guidance." Legal: any immediate red flags?
Legal: High-level ok. Need to add explicit liability language around "best-effort rollback" vs SLA. We'll draft a short amendment for pilot SOWs.
Marta: OK next steps + owners: 1) Pilot spec doc (Marta + June) 2) Ops runbook + automation (Diego + ops) 3) SDK compat shim + warning (June) 4) Pricing + SOW draft (Ravi + Legal) 5) Customer comms + Solutions playbook (Solutions leads) Target: pilot kickoff in 6 weeks, 2 customers, measurements feed into Optimize for batch suggestions.
June: I'll prototype the embed-drift monitor and a small eval harness for the shadow-run.
Diego: I'll put together the artifact retention and reserved-pool tagging plan.
Ravi: I'll scope the billing change and prepare the SOW template.
Marta: I'll create the RFC and slot time on roadmap intake. If folks are OK, I'll lock pilot customers next week. :rocket:
